label: Alien Fauna
description: Speculative-zoology wildlife: invented animals whose anatomy obeys real physics — wing loading, gait, buoyancy.

items.name: lowgrav-glider
items.text: a low-gravity glider beast soaring between rock spires, membrane wings stretched across four elongated limb struts, its body little more than keel and lung

items.name: hexapod-grazer
items.text: a six-legged grazer crossing violet steppe in a rippling paired gait, middle limbs carrying the weight while stalked eyes sweep opposite horizons

items.name: filter-strider
items.text: a stilt-legged filter-strider wading a shallow alien lagoon, trailing a fringed feeding skirt through the water, knees flexing backward like a wader's

items.name: lantern-pack
items.text: a pack of lantern-jawed predators coursing in silent formation, bioluminescent throat pouches flashing coordinated hunting signals

items.name: armored-burrower
items.text: an armored burrower breaching the dune surface, overlapping plates shedding sand in sheets, spade-clawed forelimbs still churning

items.name: sky-whale
items.text: a sky-whale drifting through the cloud deck, gas-bladder flanks translucent against the light, fin membranes rowing slowly — a floater, not a flier

items.name: spore-drifter
items.text: a jellyfish-light spore-drifter riding slope thermals, trailing meters of glassy feeding filament over the fungal canopy

items.name: highgrav-titan
items.text: a high-gravity grazer built like a bridge, four columnar legs under a compressed body, browsing through a low trunk because on this world raising a head is a structural expense

items.name: vent-reef-grazer
items.text: a blind vent-reef grazer mowing bacterial mats at the base of a black smoker, plated back shrugging off the scalding updraft, rows of tube-feet gripping the chimney rock

items.name: canopy-brachiator
items.text: a six-limbed brachiator swinging through the alien canopy on its middle and hind pairs, forelimbs freed to cradle an infant, hands worn down to permanent hooks
